FACT: Julija matched with Ned on Bumble ~September 2025. Ned did the 7h Ironman; she was swimming and recovering at the time. Ned offered the walk + coffee ('Varom kada po miestą pasivaikščiot? + kava ar whatever you prefer'). She was the busy one who couldn't meet ('tai su tavim greitu metu praktiškai neįmanoma susimatyti ane :))'). Now reconnecting on Instagram March 2026. She's preparing for a swimming marathon this summer but downplays it ('ne pro sportininke, o tiesiog šiaip, zinai'). There's a Julija recap file on the system (found via Glob). Ned's read: she's like him — can't accept praise, deflects compliments.

CONTEXT: Ned has been thinking about this reconnection, wants to keep it natural, not force a coffee invite cold after 6 months.

AFFECTS: When Ned mentions Julija, don't assume compliments land — she deflects. Don't get Ironman attribution wrong (Ned did it, not her). Don't flip who was busy on Bumble (she was busy, not him).
